note: Each `pipeline-run/**` branch holds pipeline/runs/<ST>/<run>/coverage.json with one row per registered school and a status per topic (verified_current, partially_verified_current, candidate_ready, candidate_exception, source_found, not_found, fetch_failed). Run branches are never merged, so this writes baseline/policy/pipeline_attempts.json: for every school and policy topic, the most informative status any run reached, and which run. `not_found` means the crawl of the school's official site found no page on the topic; it never means the school has no such policy.
